name: Smalland: Survive the Wilds
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The tiny-scale multiplayer survival adventure where insects tower over you. Installs the Linux dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated.
startup: set -f; v=; [ "{{VALIDATE}}" = 1 ] && v=validate; if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update {{SRCDS_APPID}} ${SRCDS_BETAID:+-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID"} ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:+-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS"} $v +quit || echo "Steam couldn't update the game, so the server starts as it is."; fi; f=start-server.sh; [ -f $f ] || { echo "start-server.sh, which holds the server's Epic Online Services keys, is missing. Reinstall the server."; exit 1; }; eos() { tr -d '\r' < $f | sed -n "s/^$1=\"\(.*\)\"$/\1/p" | head -n 1; }; dep=$(eos DEPLOYMENTID); cid=$(eos CLIENTID); sec=$(eos CLIENTSECRET); pk=$(eos PRIVATEKEY); [ -n "$dep" ] && [ -n "$cid" ] && [ -n "$sec" ] || { echo "start-server.sh has no Epic Online Services keys (DEPLOYMENTID, CLIENTID, CLIENTSECRET). Reinstall the server."; exit 1; }; exec ./SMALLAND/Binaries/Linux/SMALLANDServer-Linux-Shipping SMALLAND /Game/Maps/WorldGame/WorldGame_Smalland?SERVERNAME=\"{{SERVERNAME}}\"?WORLDNAME=\"{{WORLDNAME}}\"${PASSWORD:+?PASSWORD=\"$PASSWORD\"}$([ "{{FRIENDLYFIRE}}" = 1 ] && echo ?FRIENDLYFIRE)$([ "{{PEACEFULMODE}}" = 1 ] && echo ?PEACEFULMODE)$([ "{{KEEPINVENTORY}}" = 1 ] && echo ?KEEPINVENTORY)$([ "{{DETERIORATION}}" = 1 ] || echo ?NODETERIORATION)$([ "{{TAMEDCREATURESIMMORTAL}}" = 1 ] && echo ?TAMEDCREATURESIMMORTAL)$([ "{{PRIVATE}}" = 1 ] && echo ?PRIVATE)$([ "{{CROSSPLAY}}" = 1 ] && echo ?CROSSPLAY)?lengthofdayseconds={{LENGTHOFDAYSECONDS}}?lengthofseasonseconds={{LENGTHOFSEASONSECONDS}}?creaturehealthmodifier={{CREATUREHEALTHMODIFIER}}?creaturedamagemodifier={{CREATUREDAMAGEMODIFIER}}?nourishmentlossmodifier={{NOURISHMENTLOSSMODIFIER}}?falldamagemodifier={{FALLDAMAGEMODIFIER}}?SESSIONPLATFORM=pc -ini:Engine:[EpicOnlineServices]:DeploymentId=$dep -ini:Engine:[EpicOnlineServices]:DedicatedServerClientId=$cid -ini:Engine:[EpicOnlineServices]:DedicatedServerClientSecret=$sec ${pk:+-ini:Engine:[EpicOnlineServices]:DedicatedServerPrivateKey=$pk} -port={{SERVER_PORT}} -NOSTEAM -log

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Smalland: Survive the Wilds. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 808040) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously. Worlds are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-808040}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

chmod +x SMALLAND/Binaries/Linux/SMALLANDServer-Linux-Shipping
echo "Installed Smalland: Survive the Wilds build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: World
variables.description: The world save to load, or create when there's none by that name.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: Private
variables.description: Hide the server from the server browser.

variables.name: Crossplay
variables.description: Let players on other platforms see and join the server.

variables.name: Friendly fire
variables.description: Let players hurt each other.

variables.name: Peaceful mode
variables.description: Creatures don't attack.

variables.name: Keep inventory
variables.description: Players keep their items when they die.

variables.name: Deterioration
variables.description: Weather wears down buildings.

variables.name: Immortal tamed creatures
variables.description: Tamed creatures can't die.

variables.name: Day length
variables.description: How long a day lasts, in seconds.

variables.name: Season length
variables.description: How long a season lasts, in seconds.

variables.name: Creature health
variables.description: Creatures' health, in percent of normal.

variables.name: Creature damage
variables.description: Creatures' damage, in percent of normal.

variables.name: Hunger and thirst
variables.description: How fast players get hungry and thirsty, in percent of normal.

variables.name: Fall damage
variables.description: Fall damage, in percent of normal.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
